statements.impact_statement: The finding is in libssl3t64, shipped by the gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian13 base filesystem. Nothing in the shipped image links or loads it: the image carries one executable (the veredictum-console server; previously the veredictum CLI, adjudicated identically), whose ELF NEEDED list is libgcc_s, libm and libc only, and whose TLS is rustls — Cargo.lock contains no openssl-sys, and the only openssl-named crate is openssl-probe, a pure-Rust certificate-path prober with no libssl linkage. The image is distroless, so no shell, package manager or other program exists that could load the library. Debian's fixed package (3.5.7-1~deb13u2) is released but distroless has not rebuilt with it, so no rebuild of this image can pick it up; this statement is removed the moment a distroless rebuild carries the fix. The same adjudication, with the expiry that forces the re-check, is .trivyignore.yaml.
